proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13355 sāra explicitly gives Lahnda/Punjabi sārā, Marwari sāro, Gujarati sārũ and Marathi sārā “all, whole”. The article argues for development from “best part”, while recording the competing older account; regional borrowing remains possible.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13276 sarva gives Pali sabba, Prakrit savva, Hindi/Nepali sab, Punjabi sabh, Oriya sabu and Lahnda habh/habbā. The article explicitly discusses irregular pronoun developments and borrowing in some languages; the supported all/whole family is linked without resolving local transmission.
